original_ai_output.title_zh: 报告警告：尼日利亚2026至2027年或新增3.14万例高温相关死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 气候影响实验室（Climate Impact Lab）发布的报告警告，受异常强烈的厄尔尼诺现象影响，尼日利亚在2026年9月至2027年2月期间可能新增3.14万例高温相关死亡。报告称，萨赫勒地区预计的6.68万例新增死亡中，近一半可能发生在尼日利亚。该报告为单一来源，相关预测尚未获得其他来源交叉验证。

key_facts.fact: 报告警告尼日利亚2026年9月至2027年2月或新增3.14万例高温相关死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Nigeria could record an additional 31,400 heat-related deaths between September 2026 and February 2027 as an unusually strong El Niño weather pattern intensifies, a report by the Climate Impact Lab has warned.

key_facts.fact: 萨赫勒地区预计6.68万例新增死亡中近一半或发生在尼日利亚
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: with nearly half of the 66,800 deaths projected across the Sahel region expected to occur in the country.

key_facts.fact: 报告估计2026年6月至2027年2月全球或新增45.1万例高温相关死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: estimates that 451,000 additional heat-related deaths could occur worldwide between June 2026 and February 2027 compared with a normal year.

key_facts.fact: 报告由气候影响实验室于2026年9月22日发布
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The report, published on September 22, 2026, and titled 451,000 at Risk: Where Action Can Save Lives During the Super El Niño

uncertainties: 上述死亡数字为报告预测值，尚未证实
目前仅单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
